Cuando lo hayas ejecutado, dime hecho. Después conectaremos estos estilos a la estructura de Library.js y ajustaremos la cuadrícula para que tenga una sola fila real.

hecho, pero pulsar abajo deberia permitirnos saltar una pagaina al pulsar luego derecha o izq

Correcto. La navegación de MyFlix será por páginas, no por películas individuales.

El comportamiento será este:

Al entrar en MyFlix, aparece la información de la película seleccionada.
Pulsas ABAJO y entras en la fila de pósteres.
Pulsas DERECHA o IZQUIERDA y avanzas o retrocedes una página completa de películas.
Pulsas ARRIBA y regresas al panel de información.
La película seleccionada será la que determine el fanart y la información.
La fila seguirá siendo única y horizontal, con varios pósteres visibles simultáneamente.

Importante: no vamos a cambiar todavía la navegación global de Moonfin. La limitaremos a MyFlix para no alterar Classic ni Poster Wall.

El siguiente paso es conectar las clases que acabamos de añadir a Library.js y controlar el foco entre el panel y la fila. Primero quiero comprobar cómo está implementado el salto de página en el GridList de este proyecto, para utilizar su mecanismo real y no inventar una propiedad que no funcione.

export const createToolbarKeyDown = (gridSpotlightId, aboveSpotlightId) => (e) => {
        if (e.keyCode === KEYS.UP && aboveSpotlightId) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                Spotlight.focus(aboveSpotlightId);
                return;
        }
        if (e.keyCode !== KEYS.DOWN) return;

        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        Spotlight.focus(gridSpotlightId);
};

// Up out of the grid goes back to the toolbar, but only from the top of the list. Further
// down it's left alone so the same key keeps scrolling. A grid with a panel beside it sends
// Left there too. Both grids only pass on a Left they have no column for, so any Left that
// gets here comes from the first column.
export const createGridKeyDown = (gridClassName, aboveSpotlightId, leftSpotlightId) => (e) => {
        if (e.keyCode === KEYS.LEFT && leftSpotlightId) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                Spotlight.focus(leftSpotlightId);
                return;
        }
        if (e.keyCode !== KEYS.UP) return;

        const grid = document.querySelector(`.${gridClassName}`);
        if (!grid || (grid.scrollTop || 0) >= 50) return;

        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        Spotlight.focus(aboveSpotlightId);
};

// Right out of a panel beside the grid goes back to the grid. The letters keep the five-way,
// since Right steps along their rows and only leaves from the end of one, and so does a
// search being typed into.
export const createPanelKeyDown = (gridSpotlightId) => (e) => {
        if (e.keyCode !== KEYS.RIGHT || e.target.hasAttribute('data-letter') || e.target.tagName === 'INPUT') return;

        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        Spotlight.focus(gridSpotlightId);
};

Ahora sí: ya sabemos que createGridKeyDown solo gestiona la salida hacia arriba y, opcionalmente, hacia la izquierda. No implementa el cambio de página.

// Back on a scrolled grid returns it to its first item instead of leaving.
// Hands out the cbScrollTo receiver for the grid, a handler that consumes
// the press only once the grid has actually been scrolled, and a way to put
// the grid on any item.

import {useCallback, useRef} from 'react';
import {isListScrolledAway} from '../utils/quickReturn';

const useQuickReturnGrid = (spotlightId) => {
        const scrollToRef = useRef(null);
        const getScrollTo = useCallback((fn) => {
                scrollToRef.current = fn;
        }, []);

        const quickReturn = useCallback(() => {
                if (isListScrolledAway(spotlightId) && scrollToRef.current) {
                        scrollToRef.current({index: 0, animate: false, focus: true});
                        return true;

PS C:\Users\RaFa\Desktop\Moonfin-AeonNox>

Ya tenemos la pieza importante: Moonfin permite desplazarse a una posición concreta de la cuadrícula y cambiar el foco. La vista de juegos ya utiliza ese mecanismo para avanzar por páginas.

Para MyFlix vamos a adaptar esa lógica a una fila horizontal:

Abajo: entrar en la fila de pósteres.
Derecha/izquierda: avanzar o retroceder una página completa, manteniendo el foco en el póster equivalente.
Arriba: volver al panel de información.
Una sola fila: sin segunda línea de pósteres.
No voy a tocar gridChrome.js, porque es compartido por otras vistas.

Ahora necesito comparar ese controlador con el de Biblioteca para adaptar el comportamiento sin romper la navegación actual. Ejecuta:

powershell
copy
download
Get-Content .\packages\app\src\views\GameSystem\GameSystem.js | Select-Object -Skip 245 -First 35
Select-String -Path .\packages\app\src\views\Library\Library.js -Pattern 'gridKeyDown|handleTileFocus|GridList|cbScrollTo|getGridScrollTo|scrollGridTo' -Context 3,5
Con eso prepararé el cambio concreto en Library.js y Library.module.less, sin modificar las demás vistas.

import {memo, useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState} from 'react';
import Spotlight from '@enact/spotlight';
import Spottable from '@enact/spotlight/Spottable';
import Accelerator from '@enact/spotlight/Accelerator';
import {KEYS} from '../../utils/keys';
import {gridLayout, moveIndex, scrollRowFor} from './tileGridMath';

import css from './TileGrid.module.less';

// A grid for long lists where every focus move has to stay cheap. The grid itself is the one thing
// Spotlight focuses. It moves its own focus between tiles, reuses a fixed set of rows that each sit on
// their own layer, and slides them with a transform, so a move redraws two tiles and scrolling
// redraws one row. Spotlight only hears the presses that leave the grid.

const SpottableDiv = Spottable('div');
const DIRECTIONS = {[KEYS.LEFT]: 'left', [KEYS.RIGHT]: 'right', [KEYS.UP]: 'up', [KEYS.DOWN]: 'down'};

const translateY = (y) => {
        const value = `translateY(${y}px)`;
        return {WebkitTransform: value, transform: value};
};

const Tile = memo(({index, focused, left, width, height, renderTile}) => (
        renderTile(index, focused, {position: 'absolute', top: 0, left, width, height})
));

const Row = memo(({row, columns, dataSize, focusedColumn, tileWidth, rowHeight, renderTile}) => {
        const tiles = [];
        for (let column = 0; column < columns; column++) {
                const index = row * columns + column;
                if (index >= dataSize) break;
                tiles.push(
                        <Tile
                                key={column}
                                index={index}
                                focused={column === focusedColumn}
                                left={column * tileWidth}
                                width={tileWidth}
                                height={rowHeight}
                                renderTile={renderTile}
                        />
                );
        }
        return <div className={css.row} style={{...translateY(row * rowHeight), height: rowHeight}}>{tiles}</div>;
});

// Memoized, since the page around it redraws on every focus move to show the focused item.
const TileGrid = memo(({className, dataSize, itemSize, renderTile, spotlightId, resetKey, cbScrollTo, onFocusIndex, onKeyDown, onClick}) => {
        const viewportRef = useRef(null);
        const [size, setSize] = useState({width: 0, height: 0});
        const [focusIndex, setFocusIndex] = useState(0);
        const [firstRow, setFirstRow] = useState(0);
        const [hasFocus, setHasFocus] = useState(false);
        const [accelerator] = useState(() => new Accelerator());

        const layout = gridLayout(size.width, size.height, itemSize.minWidth, itemSize.minHeight);
        const totalRows = Math.ceil(dataSize / layout.columns);
        const stateRef = useRef();
        stateRef.current = {focusIndex, firstRow, layout, dataSize, totalRows};

        useLayoutEffect(() => {
                const measure = () => {
                        const node = viewportRef.current;
                        if (node) setSize({width: node.clientWidth, height: node.clientHeight});
                };
                measure();
                window.addEventListener('resize', measure);
                return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', measure);
        }, []);

        // A new list starts from its top, while more pages landing on the same one keep the place.
        useEffect(() => {
                setFocusIndex(0);
                setFirstRow(0);
        }, [resetKey]);

        // Reads the latest index, so a new list that also arrives shorter keeps the reset above.
        useEffect(() => {
                if (dataSize > 0 && focusIndex >= dataSize) setFocusIndex((index) => Math.min(index, dataSize - 1));
        }, [dataSize, focusIndex]);

        const moveTo = useCallback((index, scroll) => {
                const state = stateRef.current;
                setFocusIndex(index);
                if (scroll) setFirstRow(scrollRowFor(Math.floor(index / state.layout.columns), state.firstRow, state.layout.fullRows));
                if (onFocusIndex) onFocusIndex(index);
        }, [onFocusIndex]);

        useEffect(() => {
                if (!cbScrollTo) return;
                cbScrollTo(({index = 0, focus}) => {
                        const state = stateRef.current;
                        const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, state.dataSize - 1));
                        // Set ahead of the render, since taking focus reports the index right away.
                        state.focusIndex = target;
                        setFocusIndex(target);
                        setFirstRow(scrollRowFor(Math.floor(target / state.layout.columns), state.firstRow, state.layout.fullRows));
                        if (focus) Spotlight.focus(spotlightId);
                });
        }, [cbScrollTo, spotlightId]);

        // A held key can't queue moves up behind a slow frame, since any presses that land inside one
        // frame become a single move.
        const pendingRef = useRef(null);
        const applyPending = useCallback(() => {
                const direction = pendingRef.current;
                pendingRef.current = null;
                const state = stateRef.current;
                const next = moveIndex(state.focusIndex, direction, state.layout.columns, state.dataSize);
                if (next !== null) moveTo(next, true);
        }, [moveTo]);

        const handleKeyDown = useCallback((ev) => {
                const direction = DIRECTIONS[ev.keyCode];
                const state = stateRef.current;
                if (!direction || state.dataSize === 0 || moveIndex(state.focusIndex, direction, state.layout.columns, state.dataSize) === null) {
                        if (onKeyDown) onKeyDown(ev);
                        return;
                }
                ev.preventDefault();
                ev.stopPropagation();
                Spotlight.setPointerMode(false);
                accelerator.processKey(ev, () => {
                        const idle = pendingRef.current === null;
                        pendingRef.current = direction;
                        if (idle) window.requestAnimationFrame(applyPending);
                });
        }, [accelerator, applyPending, onKeyDown]);

        const handleKeyUp = useCallback((ev) => {
                accelerator.processKey(ev, () => {});
        }, [accelerator]);

        const handleFocus = useCallback(() => {
                setHasFocus(true);
                if (onFocusIndex && stateRef.current.dataSize > 0) onFocusIndex(stateRef.current.focusIndex);
        }, [onFocusIndex]);

        const handleBlur = useCallback(() => setHasFocus(false), []);

        // A pointer focuses whatever tile it's over without scrolling, so the tile stays under it. Over the
        // gaps the grid's own index is found instead, which leaves focus where it was.
        const handleMouseOver = useCallback((ev) => {
                const tile = ev.target.closest('[data-index]');
                if (!tile) return;
                const index = Number(tile.getAttribute('data-index'));
                if (index !== stateRef.current.focusIndex) moveTo(index, false);
        }, [moveTo]);

        const handleWheel = useCallback((ev) => {
                const state = stateRef.current;
                const lastFirst = Math.max(0, state.totalRows - state.layout.fullRows);
                setFirstRow(Math.max(0, Math.min(lastFirst, state.firstRow + (ev.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1))));
        }, []);

        const pool = layout.visibleRows + 2;
        const focusRow = Math.floor(focusIndex / layout.columns);
        const rows = [];
        if (size.width > 0) {
                const last = Math.min(totalRows - 1, firstRow + layout.visibleRows);
                for (let row = Math.max(0, firstRow - 1); row <= last; row++) rows.push(row);
        }

        return (
                <SpottableDiv
                        spotlightId={spotlightId}
                        className={`${css.grid} ${className || ''}`}
                        data-index={focusIndex}
                        data-scrolled={firstRow > 0}
                        data-pointer-steps
                        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
                        onKeyUp={handleKeyUp}
                        onFocus={handleFocus}
                        onBlur={handleBlur}
                        onClick={onClick}
                        onMouseOver={handleMouseOver}
                        onWheel={handleWheel}
                >
                        <div className={css.viewport} ref={viewportRef}>
                                <div className={css.track} style={translateY(-firstRow * layout.rowHeight)}>
                                        {rows.map((row) => (
                                                <Row
                                                        key={row % pool}
                                                        row={row}
                                                        columns={layout.columns}
                                                        dataSize={dataSize}
                                                        focusedColumn={hasFocus && row === focusRow ? focusIndex % layout.columns : -1}
                                                        tileWidth={layout.tileWidth}
                                                        rowHeight={layout.rowHeight}
                                                        renderTile={renderTile}
                                                />
                                        ))}
                                </div>
                        </div>
                </SpottableDiv>
        );
});

export default TileGrid;

useEffect(() => {
    if (dataSize > 0 && focusIndex >= dataSize) {
        const next = dataSize - 1;

        setFocusIndex(next);
        setFirstIndex(
            Math.max(0, next - visibleCount + 1)
        );
    }
}, [dataSize, focusIndex, visibleCount]);

const moveTo = useCallback((index) => {
    const state = stateRef.current;

    const target = Math.max(
        0,
        Math.min(index, state.dataSize - 1)
    );

    const pageStart =
        Math.floor(target / state.visibleCount) *
        state.visibleCount;

    setFocusIndex(target);

    setFirstIndex(
        Math.min(
            pageStart,
            Math.max(0, state.dataSize - state.visibleCount)
        )
    );

    if (onFocusIndex) {
        onFocusIndex(target);
    }
}, [onFocusIndex]);

const scrollTo = useCallback(({
    index = 0,
    focus = false
} = {}) => {
    moveTo(index);

    if (focus) {
        Spotlight.focus(spotlightId);
    }
}, [moveTo, spotlightId]);

useEffect(() => {
    const node = viewportRef.current;

    if (!node) return undefined;

    node.__myFlixScrollTo = scrollTo;

    return () => {
        delete node.__myFlixScrollTo;
    };
}, [scrollTo]);

const applyPending = useCallback(() => {
    const direction = pendingRef.current;

    pendingRef.current = null;

    if (!direction) return;

    const state = stateRef.current;

    const delta = direction === 'right'
        ? state.visibleCount
        : -state.visibleCount;

    moveTo(state.focusIndex + delta);
}, [moveTo]);

const handleKeyDown = useCallback((ev) => {
    const state = stateRef.current;

    if (ev.keyCode === KEYS.UP) {
        ev.preventDefault();
        ev.stopPropagation();

        if (onKeyDown) {
            onKeyDown(ev);
        }

        return;
    }

    if (
        ev.keyCode === KEYS.LEFT ||
        ev.keyCode === KEYS.RIGHT
    ) {
        const direction = ev.keyCode === KEYS.RIGHT
            ? 'right'
            : 'left';

        const next = state.focusIndex +
            (direction === 'right'
                ? state.visibleCount
                : -state.visibleCount);

        if (next < 0 || next >= state.dataSize) {
            ev.preventDefault();
            ev.stopPropagation();
            return;
        }

        ev.preventDefault();
        ev.stopPropagation();

        Spotlight.setPointerMode(false);

        accelerator.processKey(ev, () => {
            const idle = pendingRef.current === null;

            pendingRef.current = direction;

            if (idle) {
                window.requestAnimationFrame(applyPending);
            }
        });

        return;
    }

    if (onKeyDown) {
        onKeyDown(ev);
    }
}, [accelerator, applyPending, onKeyDown]);

const handleKeyUp = useCallback((ev) => {
    accelerator.processKey(ev, () => {});
}, [accelerator]);

const handleFocus = useCallback(() => {
    setHasFocus(true);

    if (onFocusIndex && dataSize > 0) {
        onFocusIndex(stateRef.current.focusIndex);
    }
}, [dataSize, onFocusIndex]);

const handleBlur = useCallback(() => {
    setHasFocus(false);
}, []);

const tiles = [];

for (
    let index = firstIndex;
    index < Math.min(dataSize, firstIndex + visibleCount);
    index++
) {
    tiles.push(
        <div
            key={index}
            data-index={index}
            className={`${css.tile} ${
                hasFocus && index === focusIndex
                    ? css.focused
                    : ''
            }`}
            style={{width: tileWidth}}
            onMouseEnter={() => moveTo(index)}
        >
            {renderTile(index, index === focusIndex, {})}
        </div>
    );
}

return (
    <SpottableDiv
        spotlightId={spotlightId}
        className={`${css.grid} ${className || ''}`}
        data-index={focusIndex}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        onKeyUp={handleKeyUp}
        onFocus={handleFocus}
        onBlur={handleBlur}
        onClick={onClick}
    >
        <div
            className={css.viewport}
            ref={viewportRef}
        >
            <div className={css.track}>
                {tiles}
            </div>
        </div>
    </SpottableDiv>
);
});export default MyFlixGrid;

const renderItem = useCallback(({index, ...rest}) => (
		items[index] ? (
			<SpottableDiv
				{...rest}
				className={css.itemCard}
				style={{padding: cellPadding}}
				onClick={handleItemClick}
				// eslint-disable-next-line react/jsx-no-bind
				onFocus={() => setFocusedItem(items[index])}
				data-index={index}
			>
				{renderCard(index)}
			</SpottableDiv>
		) : (
			<div {...rest} className={css.itemCard} style={{padding: cellPadding}}>
				{renderCard(index)}
			</div>
		)
	), [items, renderCard, cellPadding, handleItemClick]);

// The line under a card's title. Detailed sub headings spell out the year, age
// rating, runtime, resolution and score, while the plain setting keeps the year
// on its own.
const cardSubtitle = (item, isFolder, detailed) => {
	if (isFolder) {
		return item.ChildCount != null ? `${item.ChildCount} ${$L('Items')}` : $L('Folder');
	}
	if (item.Type === 'MusicAlbum') {
		if (item.Artists?.length) return item.Artists.join(', ');
		if (item.AlbumArtist) return item.AlbumArtist;
	}
	if (item.Type === 'Playlist') {
		const count = item.ChildCount ?? item.RecursiveItemCount;
		return count != null ? `${count} ${$L('Items')}` : null;
	}
	if (!detailed) return item.ProductionYear ? String(item.ProductionYear) : null;

	const parts = [];
	if (item.ProductionYear) parts.push(String(item.ProductionYear));
	if (item.OfficialRating) parts.push(item.OfficialRating);
	if (item.RunTimeTicks > 0) {
		const dur = formatDuration(item.RunTimeTicks);
		if (dur !== '0m') parts.push(dur);
	}
	const width = item.MediaSources?.[0]?.MediaStreams?.find(s => s.Type === 'Video')?.Width;
	if (width >= 3800) parts.push('â€¢ 4K');
	else if (width >= 1900) parts.push('â€¢ 1080p');
	else if (width >= 1260) parts.push('â€¢ 720p');
	if (item.CommunityRating) parts.push(`â˜… ${item.CommunityRating.toFixed(1)}`);
	return parts.length ? parts.join('  ') : null;
};
