// The line under a card's title. Detailed sub headings spell out the year, age
// rating, runtime, resolution and score, while the plain setting keeps the year
// on its own.
const cardSubtitle = (item, isFolder, detailed) => {
	if (isFolder) {
		return item.ChildCount != null ? `${item.ChildCount} ${$L('Items')}` : $L('Folder');
	}
	if (item.Type === 'MusicAlbum') {
		if (item.Artists?.length) return item.Artists.join(', ');
		if (item.AlbumArtist) return item.AlbumArtist;
	}
	if (item.Type === 'Playlist') {
		const count = item.ChildCount ?? item.RecursiveItemCount;
		return count != null ? `${count} ${$L('Items')}` : null;
	}
	if (!detailed) return item.ProductionYear ? String(item.ProductionYear) : null;

	const parts = [];
	if (item.ProductionYear) parts.push(String(item.ProductionYear));
	if (item.OfficialRating) parts.push(item.OfficialRating);
	if (item.RunTimeTicks > 0) {
		const dur = formatDuration(item.RunTimeTicks);
		if (dur !== '0m') parts.push(dur);
	}
	const width = item.MediaSources?.[0]?.MediaStreams?.find(s => s.Type === 'Video')?.Width;
	if (width >= 3800) parts.push('• 4K');
	else if (width >= 1900) parts.push('• 1080p');
	else if (width >= 1260) parts.push('• 720p');
	if (item.CommunityRating) parts.push(`★ ${item.CommunityRating.toFixed(1)}`);
	return parts.length ? parts.join('  ') : null;
};

								{POSTER_SIZE_OPTIONS.map((option) => renderRadioRow({
									key: option.key,
									label: option.label(),
									selected: imageSize === option.key,
									value: option.key,
									spotlightId: `display-size-${option.key}`,
									onClick: handlePosterSizeSelect
								}))}
							</>
						)}

						{isPlaylistLibrary && (
							<>
								<div className={css.dialogHeading}>{$L('Grouping')}</div>
								{renderCheckRow({
									label: $L('Group by Type'),
									checked: playlistGroupingOn,
									spotlightId: 'display-group-by-type',
									onToggle: handleTogglePlaylistGrouping
								})}
								<div className={css.dialogHeading}>{$L('Playlist Types')}</div>
								{PLAYLIST_CATEGORIES.map((type) => renderCheckRow({
									key: type,
									label: PLAYLIST_TYPE_LABELS[type](),
									checked: playlistTypes.includes(type),
									value: type,
									spotlightId: `display-playlist-${type}`,
									onToggle: handlePlaylistTypeToggle
								}))}
							</>
						)}
					</PanelContainer>
				</div>
			)}

			{showGroupDialog && (
				<div className={css.sortPanelOverlay} onClick={handleCloseGroupDialog}>
					<PanelContainer
						className={`${css.sortPanel} ${css.dialogNarrow}`}
						spotlightId="group-by-panel"
						onClick={stopPropagation}
					>
						<h2 className={css.sortPanelTitle}>{$L('Group By')}</h2>
						<div className={css.dialogRule} />
						{LIBRARY_GROUP_OPTIONS.map((option) => renderRadioRow({
							key: option,
							label: groupByLabel(option),
							selected: groupBy === option,
							value: option,
							spotlightId: `group-by-${option}`,
							onClick: handleGroupBySelect
						}))}
					</PanelContainer>
				</div>
			)}
		</div>
	);
};

export default Library;

// The line under a card's title. Detailed sub headings spell out the year, age
// rating, runtime, resolution and score, while the plain setting keeps the year
// on its own.
const cardSubtitle = (item, isFolder, detailed) => {
	if (isFolder) {
		return item.ChildCount != null ? `${item.ChildCount} ${$L('Items')}` : $L('Folder');
	}
	if (item.Type === 'MusicAlbum') {
		if (item.Artists?.length) return item.Artists.join(', ');
		if (item.AlbumArtist) return item.AlbumArtist;
	}
	if (item.Type === 'Playlist') {
		const count = item.ChildCount ?? item.RecursiveItemCount;
		return count != null ? `${count} ${$L('Items')}` : null;
	}
	if (!detailed) return item.ProductionYear ? String(item.ProductionYear) : null;

	const parts = [];
	if (item.ProductionYear) parts.push(String(item.ProductionYear));
	if (item.OfficialRating) parts.push(item.OfficialRating);
	if (item.RunTimeTicks > 0) {
		const dur = formatDuration(item.RunTimeTicks);
		if (dur !== '0m') parts.push(dur);
	}
	const width = item.MediaSources?.[0]?.MediaStreams?.find(s => s.Type === 'Video')?.Width;
	if (width >= 3800) parts.push('• 4K');
	else if (width >= 1900) parts.push('• 1080p');
	else if (width >= 1260) parts.push('• 720p');
	if (item.CommunityRating) parts.push(`★ ${item.CommunityRating.toFixed(1)}`);
	return parts.length ? parts.join('  ') : null;
};

					const next = {...prev};

						)}
					</PanelContainer>
				</div>
			)}

			{showGroupDialog && (
				<div className={css.sortPanelOverlay} onClick={handleCloseGroupDialog}>
					<PanelContainer
						className={`${css.sortPanel} ${css.dialogNarrow}`}
						spotlightId="group-by-panel"
						onClick={stopPropagation}
					>
						<h2 className={css.sortPanelTitle}>{$L('Group By')}</h2>
						<div className={css.dialogRule} />
						{LIBRARY_GROUP_OPTIONS.map((option) => renderRadioRow({
							key: option,
							label: groupByLabel(option),
							selected: groupBy === option,
							value: option,
							spotlightId: `group-by-${option}`,
							onClick: handleGroupBySelect
						}))}
					</PanelContainer>
				</div>
			)}
		</div>
	);
};

export default Library;

Mantiene una sola fila horizontal.
Calcula automáticamente cuántos pósteres caben.
Al pulsar derecha o izquierda, avanza o retrocede una página completa.
Resalta el póster seleccionado.
Permite que la pantalla principal gestione la tecla arriba.
Ejecuta este bloque completo en PowerShell:

powershell
copy
download
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

try {
    $path = ".\packages\app\src\components\MyFlixGrid\MyFlixGrid.js"

    $content = @'
import {memo, useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState} from 'react';
import Spotlight from '@enact/spotlight';
import Spottable from '@enact/spotlight/Spottable';
import Accelerator from '@enact/spotlight/Accelerator';
import {KEYS} from '../../utils/keys';

import css from './MyFlixGrid.module.less';

const SpottableDiv = Spottable('div');

const MyFlixGrid = memo(({
    className,
    dataSize,
    renderTile,
    spotlightId = 'library-grid',
    resetKey,
    onFocusIndex,
    onKeyDown,
    onClick,
    cbScrollTo,
    tileWidth: requestedTileWidth = 180
}) => {
    const viewportRef = useRef(null);
    const stateRef = useRef({});
    const pendingRef = useRef(null);

    const [size, setSize] = useState({width: 0, height: 0});
    const [focusIndex, setFocusIndex] = useState(0);
    const [firstIndex, setFirstIndex] = useState(0);
    const [hasFocus, setHasFocus] = useState(false);
    const [accelerator] = useState(() => new Accelerator());

    const gap = 24;
    const tileWidth = Math.max(1, requestedTileWidth);

    const visibleCount = Math.max(
        1,
        Math.floor((size.width + gap) / (tileWidth + gap))
    );

    stateRef.current = {
        focusIndex,
        firstIndex,
        visibleCount,
        dataSize
    };

    useLayoutEffect(() => {
        const measure = () => {
            const node = viewportRef.current;

            if (node) {
                setSize({
                    width: node.clientWidth,
                    height: node.clientHeight
                });
            }
        };

        measure();
        window.addEventListener('resize', measure);

        return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', measure);
    }, []);

    useEffect(() => {
        setFocusIndex(0);
        setFirstIndex(0);
    }, [resetKey]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (dataSize <= 0) {
            setFocusIndex(0);
            setFirstIndex(0);
            return;
        }

        if (focusIndex >= dataSize) {
            const next = dataSize - 1;
            setFocusIndex(next);
            setFirstIndex(
                Math.max(0, Math.min(
                    Math.floor(next / visibleCount) * visibleCount,
                    dataSize - visibleCount
                ))
            );
        }
    }, [dataSize, focusIndex, visibleCount]);

    const moveTo = useCallback((index) => {
        const state = stateRef.current;

        if (state.dataSize <= 0) return;

        const target = Math.max(
            0,
            Math.min(index, state.dataSize - 1)
        );

        const pageStart = Math.floor(target / state.visibleCount) *
            state.visibleCount;

        setFocusIndex(target);
        setFirstIndex(
            Math.min(
                pageStart,
                Math.max(0, state.dataSize - state.visibleCount)
            )
        );

        if (onFocusIndex) onFocusIndex(target);
    }, [onFocusIndex]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!cbScrollTo) return;

        cbScrollTo(({index = 0, focus = false} = {}) => {
            moveTo(index);

            if (focus) Spotlight.focus(spotlightId);
        });
    }, [cbScrollTo, moveTo, spotlightId]);

    const applyPending = useCallback(() => {
        const direction = pendingRef.current;
        pendingRef.current = null;

        if (!direction) return;

        const state = stateRef.current;
        const delta = direction === 'right'
            ? state.visibleCount
            : -state.visibleCount;

        moveTo(state.focusIndex + delta);
    }, [moveTo]);

    const handleKeyDown = useCallback((ev) => {
        const state = stateRef.current;

        if (ev.keyCode === KEYS.UP) {
            ev.preventDefault();
            ev.stopPropagation();
            if (onKeyDown) onKeyDown(ev);
            return;
        }

        if (ev.keyCode === KEYS.LEFT || ev.keyCode === KEYS.RIGHT) {
            const direction = ev.keyCode === KEYS.RIGHT ? 'right' : 'left';
            const next = state.focusIndex +
                (direction === 'right' ? state.visibleCount : -state.visibleCount);

            if (next < 0 || next >= state.dataSize) {
                ev.preventDefault();
                ev.stopPropagation();
                return;
            }

            ev.preventDefault();
            ev.stopPropagation();
            Spotlight.setPointerMode(false);

            accelerator.processKey(ev, () => {
                const idle = pendingRef.current === null;
                pendingRef.current = direction;

                if (idle) window.requestAnimationFrame(applyPending);
            });

            return;
        }

        if (onKeyDown) onKeyDown(ev);
    }, [accelerator, applyPending, onKeyDown]);

    const handleKeyUp = useCallback((ev) => {
        accelerator.processKey(ev, () => {});
    }, [accelerator]);

    const handleFocus = useCallback(() => {
        setHasFocus(true);

        if (onFocusIndex && dataSize > 0) {
            onFocusIndex(stateRef.current.focusIndex);
        }
    }, [dataSize, onFocusIndex]);

    const handleBlur = useCallback(() => setHasFocus(false), []);

    const tiles = [];

    for (
        let index = firstIndex;
        index < Math.min(dataSize, firstIndex + visibleCount);
        index++
    ) {
        tiles.push(
            <div
                key={index}
                data-index={index}
                className={`${css.tile} ${hasFocus && index === focusIndex ? css.focused : ''}`}
                style={{width: tileWidth, flexBasis: tileWidth}}
                onMouseEnter={() => moveTo(index)}
            >
                {renderTile(index, index === focusIndex, {})}
            </div>
        );
    }

    return (
        <SpottableDiv
            spotlightId={spotlightId}
            className={`${css.grid} ${className || ''}`}
            data-index={focusIndex}
            onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
            onKeyUp={handleKeyUp}
            onFocus={handleFocus}
            onBlur={handleBlur}
            onClick={onClick}
        >
            <div className={css.viewport} ref={viewportRef}>
                <div className={css.track}>{tiles}</div>
            </div>
        </SpottableDiv>
    );
});

export default MyFlixGrid;
'@

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        (Resolve-Path $path).Path,
        $content,
        [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    )

    Write-Host "MyFlixGrid actualizado correctamente." -ForegroundColor Green
}
catch {
    Write-Host "ERROR: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
}

PS C:\Users\RaFa\Desktop\Moonfin-AeonNox>

Ya tenemos las medidas exactas. Moonfin calcula el ancho de cada tarjeta mediante gridItemSize.minWidth, así que vamos a reutilizarlo para que MyFlix no tenga pósteres desproporcionados ni calcule mal las páginas.

Primero ejecuta este cambio automático: añade el ancho real de tarjeta a MyFlixGrid.

powershell
copy
download
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

try {
    $path = ".\packages\app\src\views\Library\Library.js"
    $content = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText((Resolve-Path $path))

    $old = @'
        dataSize={items.length}
        renderTile={renderTile}
'@

    $new = @'
        dataSize={items.length}
        tileWidth={gridItemSize.minWidth}
        renderTile={renderTile}
'@

    if (-not $content.Contains($old)) {
        throw "No se encontró el bloque de propiedades de MyFlixGrid."
    }

    Copy-Item $path "$path.before-tile-width.bak"
    $content = $content.Replace($old, $new)

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        (Resolve-Path $path).Path,
        $content,
        [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    )

    Write-Host "Ancho real de tarjeta conectado." -ForegroundColor Green
}
catch {
    Write-Host "ERROR: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
}

Read-Host "Pulsa ENTER para continuar"

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

try {
    $path = ".\packages\app\src\views\Library\Library.js"
    $content = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText((Resolve-Path $path))

    $replacements = @(
        @{
            Old = '<div className={css.page}>'
            New = '<div className={libraryStyle === ''myflix'' ? `${css.page} ${css.myflixPage}` : css.page}>'
        },
        @{
            Old = '<div className={isDocked ? `${css.content} ${css.contentDocked}` : css.content}>'
            New = '<div className={libraryStyle === ''myflix'' ? `${css.content} ${css.myflixContent}` : (isDocked ? `${css.content} ${css.contentDocked}` : css.content)}>'
        },
        @{
            Old = '<div className={css.focusedInfo}>'
            New = '<div className={libraryStyle === ''myflix'' ? `${css.focusedInfo} ${css.myflixInfo}` : css.focusedInfo}>'
        },
        @{
            Old = '<GridContainer className={css.gridContainer} spotlightId="library-grid-area">'
            New = '<GridContainer className={libraryStyle === ''myflix'' ? `${css.gridContainer} ${css.myflixGridContainer}` : css.gridContainer} spotlightId="library-grid-area">'
        },
        @{
            Old = '<div className={css.gridWrapper}>'
            New = '<div className={libraryStyle === ''myflix'' ? `${css.gridWrapper} ${css.myflixGridWrapper}` : css.gridWrapper}>'
        },
        @{
            Old = '<div className={css.gridWrapper} {...menuHold}>'
            New = '<div className={libraryStyle === ''myflix'' ? `${css.gridWrapper} ${css.myflixGridWrapper}` : css.gridWrapper} {...menuHold}>'
        }
    )

    foreach ($item in $replacements) {
        if (-not $content.Contains($item.Old)) {
            throw "No se encontró el fragmento: $($item.Old)"
        }
    }

    $backup = "$path.before-myflix-layout.bak"
    if (Test-Path $backup) {
        $backup = "$path.before-myflix-layout-$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss').bak"
    }
    Copy-Item $path $backup

    foreach ($item in $replacements) {
        $content = $content.Replace($item.Old, $item.New)
    }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        (Resolve-Path $path).Path,
        $content,
        [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    )

    Write-Host "Clases visuales MyFlix conectadas." -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host "Copia de seguridad: $backup" -ForegroundColor Cyan
}
catch {
    Write-Host "ERROR: $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red
}

Read-Host "Pulsa ENTER para continuar"

$path = ".\packages\app\src\views\Library\Library.js"
$lines = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
(Get-Content $path).ForEach({ $lines.Add($_) })

# Localizar y añadir los dos controladores MyFlix
$navIndex = -1
for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {
    if ($lines[$i] -match 'const gridKeyDown = groupTabs') {
        $navIndex = $i
        break
    }
}
if ($navIndex -lt 0) { throw "No se encontró gridKeyDown." }

$navEnd = -1
for ($i = $navIndex; $i -lt [Math]::Min($navIndex + 8, $lines.Count); $i++) {
    if ($lines[$i] -match "libraryStyle === 'modern'.*handleGridKeyDownNoLetters;") {
        $navEnd = $i
        break
    }
}
if ($navEnd -lt 0) { throw "No se encontró el final de gridKeyDown." }

if (-not ($lines -join "`n").Contains('handleMyFlixInfoKeyDown')) {
    $handlers = @(
        ''
        ' const handleMyFlixInfoKeyDown = useCallback((ev) => {'
        '     if (ev.keyCode !== KEYS.DOWN) return;'
        '     ev.preventDefault();'
        '     ev.stopPropagation();'
        "     Spotlight.focus('library-grid');"
        ' }, []);'
        ''
        ' const handleMyFlixGridKeyDown = useCallback((ev) => {'
        '     if (ev.keyCode === KEYS.UP) {'
        '         ev.preventDefault();'
        '         ev.stopPropagation();'
        "         Spotlight.focus('library-info');"
        '         return;'
        '     }'
        '     if (gridKeyDown) gridKeyDown(ev);'
        ' }, [gridKeyDown]);'
    )
    $lines.InsertRange($navEnd + 1, [string[]]$handlers)
}

# Hacer que el panel MyFlix sea enfocable
$infoCondition = -1
$infoOpening = -1
for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {
    if ($lines[$i] -match 'settings\?\.showMediaDetailsOnLibraryPage !== false') {
        $infoCondition = $i
        break
    }
}
if ($infoCondition -lt 0) { throw "No se encontró la condición del panel." }

for ($i = $infoCondition + 1; $i -lt [Math]::Min($infoCondition + 5, $lines.Count); $i++) {
    if ($lines[$i] -match '<div className=.*focusedInfo') {
        $infoOpening = $i
        break
    }
}
if ($infoOpening -lt 0) { throw "No se encontró la apertura del panel." }

$indent = ([regex]::Match($lines[$infoOpening], '^\s*')).Value
$lines[$infoCondition] = $indent + "{(libraryStyle === 'myflix' || settings?.showMediaDetailsOnLibraryPage !== false) && ("
$lines[$infoOpening] = $indent + '<SpottableDiv'
$lines.Insert($infoOpening + 1, $indent + "        className={libraryStyle === 'myflix' ? `${css.focusedInfo} `${css.myflixInfo}` : css.focusedInfo}")
$lines.Insert($infoOpening + 2, $indent + "        spotlightId={libraryStyle === 'myflix' ? 'library-info' : undefined}")
$lines.Insert($infoOpening + 3, $indent + "        spotlightDisabled={libraryStyle !== 'myflix'}")
$lines.Insert($infoOpening + 4, $indent + "        onKeyDown={libraryStyle === 'myflix' ? handleMyFlixInfoKeyDown : undefined}")
$lines.Insert($infoOpening + 5, $indent + '>')

# Cambiar el cierre del panel, no otros divs
$ratingIndex = -1
for ($i = $infoOpening; $i -lt [Math]::Min($infoOpening + 30, $lines.Count); $i++) {
    if ($lines[$i] -match '<RatingsRow item=\{focusedItem\}') {
        $ratingIndex = $i
        break
    }
}
if ($ratingIndex -lt 0) { throw "No se encontró RatingsRow dentro del panel." }

$panelClose = -1
for ($i = $ratingIndex + 1; $i -lt [Math]::Min($ratingIndex + 8, $lines.Count); $i++) {
    if ($lines[$i].Trim() -eq '</div>') {
        $panelClose = $i
        break
    }
}
if ($panelClose -lt 0) { throw "No se encontró el cierre del panel." }
$lines[$panelClose] = $lines[$panelClose].Replace('</div>', '</SpottableDiv>')

# Cambiar solo el onKeyDown de MyFlixGrid
$gridIndex = -1
for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {
    if ($lines[$i] -match 'className=\{css\.myflixGrid\}') {
        $gridIndex = $i
        break
    }
}
if ($gridIndex -lt 0) { throw "No se encontró MyFlixGrid." }

$gridKeyIndex = -1
for ($i = $gridIndex; $i -lt [Math]::Min($gridIndex + 15, $lines.Count); $i++) {
    if ($lines[$i] -match 'onKeyDown=\{gridKeyDown\}') {
        $gridKeyIndex = $i
        break
    }
}
if ($gridKeyIndex -lt 0) { throw "No se encontró onKeyDown de MyFlixGrid." }
$lines[$gridKeyIndex] = $lines[$gridKeyIndex].Replace('onKeyDown={gridKeyDown}', 'onKeyDown={handleMyFlixGridKeyDown}')

# Guardar solo después de validar todos los puntos
Copy-Item $path "$path.beforeMyFlixFocus" -Force

    (Resolve-Path $path),
    ($lines -join [Environment]::NewLine),
    [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)

Ya veo algo importante en el JSX: el panel de información y la fila de pósteres son elementos hermanos, pero el panel depende de que focusedItem tenga un valor. Si el foco no actualiza correctamente ese estado, el panel queda vacío.

También hay que separar dos comportamientos: el foco del mando y el desplazamiento por páginas. No quiero cambiar las flechas hasta comprobar cómo se actualiza el elemento seleccionado.

Ejecuta este comando para revisar esas conexiones:

powershell
copy
download
$file = ".\packages\app\src\views\Library\Library.js"
Select-String -Path $file -Pattern "const renderCard|const renderTile|const handleTileFocus|const handleMyFlixInfoKeyDown|const handleMyFlixGridKeyDown|const handleItemClick|const page" -Context 3,12
Con ese resultado podremos corregir el foco, recuperar la información de la izquierda y evitar que los títulos se monten unos sobre otros. Después ajustaremos el degradado negro para que el fanart se vea con más luminosidad.

import {useEffect, useRef, memo} from 'react';
import {getPerfTier} from '../../utils/perfTier';
import {serverBlurredUrl} from '../../utils/serverBlur';

import css from './BackdropLayer.module.less';

const BACKDROP_DEBOUNCE_MS = 500;

const TIER_BLUR_CAPS = {low: 0, mid: 8, high: 20};

const clampBlur = (amount) => {
        const cap = TIER_BLUR_CAPS[getPerfTier()];
        return Math.min(amount || 0, cap);
};

const FADE_CLASS = {corner: css.cornerFadeDown, top: css.topFade};

const BackdropLayer = memo(({targetUrl: requestedUrl, blurAmount, overlayOpacity, placement}) => {
        const blurredUrl = serverBlurredUrl(requestedUrl, blurAmount);
        const targetUrl = blurredUrl || requestedUrl;
        const layerARef = useRef(null);
        const layerBRef = useRef(null);
        const activeLayerRef = useRef('a');
        const currentUrlRef = useRef('');
        const timeoutRef = useRef(null);

        useEffect(() => {
                return () => {
                        if (timeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
                };
        }, []);

        useEffect(() => {
                if (!targetUrl) {
                        if (currentUrlRef.current) {
                                currentUrlRef.current = '';
                                if (layerARef.current) layerARef.current.style.opacity = '0';
                                if (layerBRef.current) layerBRef.current.style.opacity = '0';
                        }
                        if (timeoutRef.current) {
                                clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
                                timeoutRef.current = null;
                        }
                        return;
                }

                if (targetUrl === currentUrlRef.current) return;

                if (timeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);

                timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
                        const img = new window.Image();
                        const apply = () => {
                                const isA = activeLayerRef.current === 'a';
                                const incoming = isA ? layerBRef.current : layerARef.current;
                                const outgoing = isA ? layerARef.current : layerBRef.current;
                                if (!incoming || !outgoing) return;

                                incoming.style.transition = 'none';
                                incoming.style.opacity = '0';
                                incoming.style.backgroundImage = `url(${targetUrl})`;

                                incoming.offsetHeight; // eslint-disable-line @babel/no-unused-expressions
                                incoming.style.transition = '';
                                incoming.style.opacity = '1';
                                outgoing.style.opacity = '0';

                                activeLayerRef.current = isA ? 'b' : 'a';
                                currentUrlRef.current = targetUrl;
                        };
                        img.onload = apply;
                        img.onerror = apply;
                        img.src = targetUrl;
                }, BACKDROP_DEBOUNCE_MS);
        }, [targetUrl]);

        const effectiveBlur = blurredUrl ? 0 : clampBlur(blurAmount);
        const filter = effectiveBlur > 0 ? `blur(${effectiveBlur}px)` : 'none';
        // A server blur darkens the edges like a CSS one, so both keep the oversize that hides them.
        const layerStyle = blurredUrl || effectiveBlur > 0
                ? {WebkitFilter: filter, filter}
                : {WebkitFilter: 'none', filter: 'none', top: 0, left: 0, width: '100%', height: '100%'};

        // How much picture shows through is the screen's own call, since a page laying
        // a grid over the whole thing needs more of it covered than one that only
        // wants the colour.
        const overlayStyle = typeof overlayOpacity === 'number' ? {opacity: overlayOpacity} : undefined;

        return (
                <div className={css.globalBackdrop}>
                        {/* The frames stay mounted either way, so the layers keep the picture they hold */}
                        <div className={placement === 'corner' ? css.cornerFadeLeft : css.fill}>
                                <div className={FADE_CLASS[placement] || css.fill}>
                                        <div
                                                ref={layerARef}
                                                className={css.globalBackdropImage}
                                                style={layerStyle}
                                        />
                                        <div
                                                ref={layerBRef}
                                                className={css.globalBackdropImage}
                                                style={layerStyle}
                                        />
                                </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className={css.globalBackdropOverlay} style={overlayStyle} />
                </div>
        );
});

export default BackdropLayer;

Ahora sí hemos localizado una causa importante: BackdropLayer tiene una capa oscura adicional (theme-scrim) con una opacidad predeterminada del 75 %. Además, tiene degradados laterales e inferiores.

Y tomo nota: siguen pendientes las flechas, la separación de los pósteres y la información de la izquierda. No vamos a dar el diseño por corregido hasta comprobar esos cuatro puntos.

Primero vamos a quitar el oscurecimiento exclusivamente en MyFlix, sin afectar a las demás pantallas.

        if (state.dataSize <= 0) return;

        const target = Math.max(
            0,

        const pageStart = Math.floor(target / state.visibleCount) *

const SpottableDiv = Spottable('div');

const MyFlixGrid = memo(({
    className,
    dataSize,
    renderTile,
    spotlightId = 'library-grid',
    resetKey,
    onFocusIndex,
    onKeyDown,
    onClick,
    cbScrollTo,
    tileWidth: requestedTileWidth = 180
}) => {
    const viewportRef = useRef(null);
    const stateRef = useRef({});
    const pendingRef = useRef(null);

    const [focusIndex, setFocusIndex] = useState(0);
    const [firstIndex, setFirstIndex] = useState(0);
    const [hasFocus, setHasFocus] = useState(false);
    const [accelerator] = useState(() => new Accelerator());

    const gap = 24;

        1,
        Math.floor((size.width + gap) / (tileWidth + gap))
    );

        focusIndex,
        firstIndex,
        visibleCount,
        dataSize
    };

    useLayoutEffect(() => {
        const measure = () => {
            const node = viewportRef.current;

                    width: node.clientWidth,
                    height: node.clientHeight
                });

        };

        measure();

        return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', measure);

$pattern = '(?s)    const applyPending = useCallback\(.*?(?=    const handleFocus = useCallback)'

$replacement = @'
    const handleKeyDown = useCallback((ev) => {
        const state = stateRef.current;

        if (ev.keyCode === KEYS.UP) {
            ev.preventDefault();
            ev.stopPropagation();
            if (onKeyDown) onKeyDown(ev);
            return;
        }

        if (ev.keyCode === KEYS.LEFT || ev.keyCode === KEYS.RIGHT) {
            ev.preventDefault();
            ev.stopPropagation();
            Spotlight.setPointerMode(false);

            const delta = ev.keyCode === KEYS.RIGHT
                ? state.visibleCount
                : -state.visibleCount;

            const next = state.focusIndex + delta;

            if (next >= 0 && next < state.dataSize) {
                moveTo(next);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (onKeyDown) onKeyDown(ev);
    }, [moveTo, onKeyDown]);

    const handleKeyDown = useCallback((ev) => {
        const state = stateRef.current;

        if (ev.keyCode === KEYS.UP) {
            ev.preventDefault();
            ev.stopPropagation();
            if (onKeyDown) onKeyDown(ev);
            return;
        }

        if (ev.keyCode === KEYS.LEFT || ev.keyCode === KEYS.RIGHT) {
            ev.preventDefault();
            ev.stopPropagation();
            Spotlight.setPointerMode(false);

            const delta = ev.keyCode === KEYS.RIGHT
                ? state.visibleCount
                : -state.visibleCount;

            const next = state.focusIndex + delta;

            if (next >= 0 && next < state.dataSize) {
                moveTo(next);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (onKeyDown) onKeyDown(ev);
    }, [moveTo, onKeyDown]);
    const handleFocus = useCallback(() => {
        setHasFocus(true);

        if (onFocusIndex && dataSize > 0) {
            onFocusIndex(stateRef.current.focusIndex);
        }
    }, [dataSize, onFocusIndex]);

    const handleBlur = useCallback(() => setHasFocus(false), []);

    const tiles = [];

    for (
        let index = firstIndex;
        index < Math.min(dataSize, firstIndex + visibleCount);
        index++
    ) {
        tiles.push(
            <div
                key={index}
                data-index={index}
                className={`${css.tile} ${hasFocus && index === focusIndex ? css.focused : ''}`}
                style={{width: tileWidth, flexBasis: tileWidth}}
                onMouseEnter={() => moveTo(index)}
            >
                {renderTile(index, index === focusIndex, {})}
            </div>
        );
    }

    return (
        <SpottableDiv
            spotlightId={spotlightId}
            className={`${css.grid} ${className || ''}`}
            data-index={focusIndex}
            onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
            onFocus={handleFocus}
            onBlur={handleBlur}
            onClick={onClick}
        >
            <div className={css.viewport} ref={viewportRef}>
                <div className={css.track}>{tiles}</div>
            </div>
        </SpottableDiv>
    );
});

export default MyFlixGrid;

Ahora sí tenemos lo necesario. La solución va a separar realmente los dos controles:

En el panel izquierdo, izquierda/derecha cambia una ventana completa.
Al bajar a los pósteres, izquierda/derecha selecciona el título siguiente o anterior.
Al subir, se recupera el foco del panel izquierdo.
El panel izquierdo mostrará desde el principio la información del primer título y se actualizará al cambiar la selección.
Haz una copia de seguridad y aplica este bloque completo en PowerShell:

powershell
copy
download
$base = "C:\Users\RaFa\Desktop\Moonfin-AeonNox\packages\app\src"
$grid = Join-Path $base "components\MyFlixGrid\MyFlixGrid.js"
$lib = Join-Path $base "views\Library\Library.js"

Copy-Item $grid "$grid.before-dual-navigation.bak" -Force
Copy-Item $lib "$lib.before-dual-navigation.bak" -Force

# 1. MyFlixGrid: movimiento individual dentro de la fila
$g = Get-Content $grid -Raw
$g = [regex]::Replace($g, "import Accelerator from '@enact/spotlight/Accelerator';\r?\n", "")
$g = [regex]::Replace($g, "^\s*const pendingRef = useRef\(null\);\r?\n", "", "Multiline")
$g = [regex]::Replace($g, "^\s*const \[accelerator\] = useState\(\(\) => new Accelerator\(\)\);\r?\n", "", "Multiline")

$handler = @'
    const handleKeyDown = useCallback((ev) => {
        const state = stateRef.current;

        if (ev.keyCode === KEYS.UP) {
            ev.preventDefault();
            ev.stopPropagation();
            if (onKeyDown) onKeyDown(ev);
            return;
        }

        if (ev.keyCode === KEYS.LEFT || ev.keyCode === KEYS.RIGHT) {
            ev.preventDefault();
            ev.stopPropagation();
            Spotlight.setPointerMode(false);

            const delta = ev.keyCode === KEYS.RIGHT ? 1 : -1;
            const next = state.focusIndex + delta;

            if (next >= 0 && next < state.dataSize) {
                moveTo(next);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (onKeyDown) onKeyDown(ev);
    }, [moveTo, onKeyDown]);

'@

$g = [regex]::Replace(
    $g,
    '(?s)    const handleKeyDown = useCallback\(.*?(?=    const handleFocus = useCallback)',
    $handler
)

PS C:\Users\RaFa\Desktop\Moonfin-AeonNox>

La navegación ya está funcionando, así que no la vamos a tocar.

He localizado dos causas probables del aspecto que describes: las tarjetas reutilizan estilos generales de Moonfin y el contenido de texto de las tarjetas incluye subtítulos y metadatos. Para MyFlix conviene aplicar un formato propio: póster de tamaño fijo, título únicamente y panel de información independiente.

Necesito ver el bloque completo que calcula el tamaño y elige la imagen, además del estilo general del panel. Ejecuta:

powershell
copy
download
$lib = "C:\Users\RaFa\Desktop\Moonfin-AeonNox\packages\app\src\views\Library\Library.js"
$css = "C:\Users\RaFa\Desktop\Moonfin-AeonNox\packages\app\src\views\Library\Library.module.less"

$lines = Get-Content $lib
$lines[1260..1365]
$lines[440..458]

Write-Host "`n--- ESTILOS DEL PANEL Y TARJETAS ---"
$styles = Get-Content $css
$styles[180..230]
$styles[1080..1165]
Con eso preparo un único parche para corregir las carátulas, quitar los datos sobrantes y recuperar la información de la izquierda.

                ? Math.round(bannerWidth / BANNER_ASPECT)
                : isWideImage
                        ? ({small: 128, medium: 160, large: 191, extraLarge: 223}[imageSize] || 160)
                        : POSTER_HEIGHTS[imageSize];

        // A subtitle anywhere in the library makes room for a second line on every
        // card, so the rows stay level whether or not a given item has one.
        const hasCardSubtitles = useMemo(() => (
                showCardText && items.some((item) => (
                        cardSubtitle(item, isFolderView && item.IsFolder && !FOLDER_DETAIL_TYPES.includes(item.Type), detailedSubtitles)
                ))
        ), [items, showCardText, isFolderView, detailedSubtitles]);

        const textHeight = showCardText ? (hasCardSubtitles ? 61 : 35) : 0;
        // A square card is as wide as it is tall.
        const cardWidth = isBanner
                ? bannerWidth
                : isSquareImage
                ? posterHeight
                : isWideImage
                        ? ({small: 227, medium: 284, large: 340, extraLarge: 397}[imageSize] || 284)
                        : ({small: 116, medium: 145, large: 174, extraLarge: 203}[imageSize] || 145);
        const cardHeight = posterHeight + textHeight;

        const cellPadX = horizontalCellPad(cardWidth, gridWidth);
        const cellPadY = Math.max(MIN_ROW_GAP, focusOverhang(cardHeight));
        const cellPadding = `${cellPadY}px ${cellPadX}px`;
        const gridItemSize = useMemo(() => (
                {minWidth: cardWidth + cellPadX * 2, minHeight: cardHeight + cellPadY * 2}
        ), [cardWidth, cardHeight, cellPadX, cellPadY]);

        const renderCard = useCallback((index) => {
                const item = items[index];
                const isNearEnd = index >= items.length - 50;
                if (isNearEnd && apiFetchIndexRef.current < totalCount && !isLoading && !loadingMoreRef.current) {
                        loadItems(apiFetchIndexRef.current, true);

                if (isWideImage && item.ImageTags?.Thumb) {
                        imageId = item.Id;
                        imgApiType = 'Thumb';
                } else if (isBanner) {
                        // Cropping a portrait poster down to a banner loses the most, so it comes last.
                        const wide = ['Banner', 'Backdrop', 'Thumb'].find((type) => (type === 'Backdrop' ? item.BackdropImageTags?.length : item.ImageTags?.[type]));
                        if (wide) {
                                imageId = item.Id;
                                imgApiType = wide;
                        }

Ya veo dos causas claras:

Las carátulas se recortan porque .poster usa object-fit: cover. Para respetar la imagen original, lo cambiaremos a contain.
Los títulos largos pueden invadir la tarjeta siguiente. Limitaremos el título a dos líneas y ocultaremos el exceso.
Además, tileWidth sí está conectado al ancho calculado de cada tarjeta; no hace falta tocar MyFlixGrid ni la navegación.

Antes de aplicar los cambios, necesito comprobar el CSS exacto del texto y la consulta de Jellyfin para incluir la sinopsis y los metadatos que faltan.

import {useEffect, useRef, memo} from 'react';
import {getPerfTier} from '../../utils/perfTier';
import {serverBlurredUrl} from '../../utils/serverBlur';

import css from './BackdropLayer.module.less';

const BACKDROP_DEBOUNCE_MS = 500;

const TIER_BLUR_CAPS = {low: 0, mid: 8, high: 20};

const clampBlur = (amount) => {
        const cap = TIER_BLUR_CAPS[getPerfTier()];
        return Math.min(amount || 0, cap);
};

const FADE_CLASS = {corner: css.cornerFadeDown, top: css.topFade};

const BackdropLayer = memo(({targetUrl: requestedUrl, blurAmount, overlayOpacity, placement}) => {
        const blurredUrl = serverBlurredUrl(requestedUrl, blurAmount);
        const targetUrl = blurredUrl || requestedUrl;
        const layerARef = useRef(null);
        const layerBRef = useRef(null);
        const activeLayerRef = useRef('a');
        const currentUrlRef = useRef('');
        const timeoutRef = useRef(null);

        useEffect(() => {
                return () => {
                        if (timeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
                };
        }, []);

        useEffect(() => {
                if (!targetUrl) {
                        if (currentUrlRef.current) {
                                currentUrlRef.current = '';
                                if (layerARef.current) layerARef.current.style.opacity = '0';
                                if (layerBRef.current) layerBRef.current.style.opacity = '0';
                        }
                        if (timeoutRef.current) {
                                clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
                                timeoutRef.current = null;
                        }
                        return;
                }

                if (targetUrl === currentUrlRef.current) return;

                if (timeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);

                timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
                        const img = new window.Image();
                        const apply = () => {
                                const isA = activeLayerRef.current === 'a';
                                const incoming = isA ? layerBRef.current : layerARef.current;
                                const outgoing = isA ? layerARef.current : layerBRef.current;
                                if (!incoming || !outgoing) return;

                                incoming.style.transition = 'none';
                                incoming.style.opacity = '0';
                                incoming.style.backgroundImage = `url(${targetUrl})`;

                                incoming.offsetHeight; // eslint-disable-line @babel/no-unused-expressions
                                incoming.style.transition = '';
                                incoming.style.opacity = '1';
                                outgoing.style.opacity = '0';

                                activeLayerRef.current = isA ? 'b' : 'a';
                                currentUrlRef.current = targetUrl;
                        };
                        img.onload = apply;
                        img.onerror = apply;
                        img.src = targetUrl;
                }, BACKDROP_DEBOUNCE_MS);
        }, [targetUrl]);

        const effectiveBlur = blurredUrl ? 0 : clampBlur(blurAmount);
        const filter = effectiveBlur > 0 ? `blur(${effectiveBlur}px)` : 'none';
        // A server blur darkens the edges like a CSS one, so both keep the oversize that hides them.
        const layerStyle = blurredUrl || effectiveBlur > 0
                ? {WebkitFilter: filter, filter}
                : {WebkitFilter: 'none', filter: 'none', top: 0, left: 0, width: '100%', height: '100%'};

        // How much picture shows through is the screen's own call, since a page laying
        // a grid over the whole thing needs more of it covered than one that only
        // wants the colour.
        const overlayStyle = typeof overlayOpacity === 'number' ? {opacity: overlayOpacity} : undefined;

        return (
                <div className={css.globalBackdrop}>
                        {/* The frames stay mounted either way, so the layers keep the picture they hold */}
                        <div className={placement === 'corner' ? css.cornerFadeLeft : css.fill}>
                                <div className={FADE_CLASS[placement] || css.fill}>
                                        <div
                                                ref={layerARef}
                                                className={css.globalBackdropImage}
                                                style={layerStyle}
                                        />
                                        <div
                                                ref={layerBRef}
                                                className={css.globalBackdropImage}
                                                style={layerStyle}
                                        />
                                </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className={css.globalBackdropOverlay} style={overlayStyle} />
                </div>
        );
});

export default BackdropLayer;

--- SISTEMA DE URL DE FONDOS ---
// Jellyfin and Emby blur artwork on request, so a blurred backdrop costs no more to draw than a plain
// one, where a CSS blur filter is slow on any TV that paints in software. The request shrinks by the
// same factor as the blur, which keeps the radius on screen the same and leaves a far smaller image
// to decode. The servers only take a whole number, and every blur option divides evenly by this.
const SHRINK = 5;

// The url asking the server for the blurred image, or null when the artwork isn't the server's own
// and the caller has to blur it some other way.
export const serverBlurredUrl = (url, blur) => {
        if (!(blur > 0) || !/\/Items\/[^/?]+\/Images\//.test(url)) return null;
        const [path, query] = url.split('?');
        const params = (query || '').split('&').filter((param) => param && !/^(maxWidth|maxHeight|blur)=/i.test(param));
        params.push(`maxWidth=${Math.round((window.innerWidth || 1920) / SHRINK)}`, `blur=${Math.max(1, Math.round(blur / SHRINK))}`);
        return `${path}?${params.join('&')}`;
};

import {useEffect, useRef, memo} from 'react';
import {getPerfTier} from '../../utils/perfTier';
import {serverBlurredUrl} from '../../utils/serverBlur';

import css from './BackdropLayer.module.less';

const BACKDROP_DEBOUNCE_MS = 500;

const TIER_BLUR_CAPS = {low: 0, mid: 8, high: 20};

const clampBlur = (amount) => {
        const cap = TIER_BLUR_CAPS[getPerfTier()];
        return Math.min(amount || 0, cap);
};

const FADE_CLASS = {corner: css.cornerFadeDown, top: css.topFade};

const BackdropLayer = memo(({targetUrl: requestedUrl, blurAmount, overlayOpacity, placement}) => {
        const blurredUrl = serverBlurredUrl(requestedUrl, blurAmount);
        const targetUrl = blurredUrl || requestedUrl;
        const layerARef = useRef(null);
        const layerBRef = useRef(null);
        const activeLayerRef = useRef('a');
        const currentUrlRef = useRef('');
        const timeoutRef = useRef(null);

        useEffect(() => {
                return () => {
                        if (timeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
                };
        }, []);

        useEffect(() => {
                if (!targetUrl) {
                        if (currentUrlRef.current) {
                                currentUrlRef.current = '';
                                if (layerARef.current) layerARef.current.style.opacity = '0';
                                if (layerBRef.current) layerBRef.current.style.opacity = '0';
                        }
                        if (timeoutRef.current) {
                                clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
                                timeoutRef.current = null;
                        }
                        return;
                }

                if (targetUrl === currentUrlRef.current) return;

                if (timeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);

                timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
                        const img = new window.Image();
                        const apply = () => {
                                const isA = activeLayerRef.current === 'a';
                                const incoming = isA ? layerBRef.current : layerARef.current;
                                const outgoing = isA ? layerARef.current : layerBRef.current;
                                if (!incoming || !outgoing) return;

                                incoming.style.transition = 'none';
                                incoming.style.opacity = '0';
                                incoming.style.backgroundImage = `url(${targetUrl})`;

                                incoming.offsetHeight; // eslint-disable-line @babel/no-unused-expressions
                                incoming.style.transition = '';
                                incoming.style.opacity = '1';
                                outgoing.style.opacity = '0';

                                activeLayerRef.current = isA ? 'b' : 'a';
                                currentUrlRef.current = targetUrl;
                        };
                        img.onload = apply;
                        img.onerror = apply;
                        img.src = targetUrl;
                }, BACKDROP_DEBOUNCE_MS);
        }, [targetUrl]);

        const effectiveBlur = blurredUrl ? 0 : clampBlur(blurAmount);
        const filter = effectiveBlur > 0 ? `blur(${effectiveBlur}px)` : 'none';
        // A server blur darkens the edges like a CSS one, so both keep the oversize that hides them.
        const layerStyle = blurredUrl || effectiveBlur > 0
                ? {WebkitFilter: filter, filter}
                : {WebkitFilter: 'none', filter: 'none', top: 0, left: 0, width: '100%', height: '100%'};

        // How much picture shows through is the screen's own call, since a page laying
        // a grid over the whole thing needs more of it covered than one that only
        // wants the colour.
        const overlayStyle = typeof overlayOpacity === 'number' ? {opacity: overlayOpacity} : undefined;

        return (
                <div className={css.globalBackdrop}>
                        {/* The frames stay mounted either way, so the layers keep the picture they hold */}
                        <div className={placement === 'corner' ? css.cornerFadeLeft : css.fill}>
                                <div className={FADE_CLASS[placement] || css.fill}>
                                        <div
                                                ref={layerARef}
                                                className={css.globalBackdropImage}
                                                style={layerStyle}
                                        />
                                        <div
                                                ref={layerBRef}
                                                className={css.globalBackdropImage}
                                                style={layerStyle}
                                        />
                                </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className={css.globalBackdropOverlay} style={overlayStyle} />
                </div>
        );
});

export default BackdropLayer;

import {buildQueryString} from './urlCompat';
import {uiLocale} from './uiLocale';
import {parseServerDate} from './serverDate';
import {isPlexServer, plexImageUrl} from './plexUrls';

export const formatDuration = (ticks) => {
        if (!ticks) return '';
        const totalMinutes = Math.floor(ticks / 600000000);
        const hours = Math.floor(totalMinutes / 60);
        const minutes = totalMinutes % 60;
        if (hours > 0) {
                return `${hours}h ${minutes}m`;
        }
        return `${minutes}m`;
};

export const formatDate = (dateString) => {
        const date = parseServerDate(dateString);
        return date ? date.toLocaleDateString(uiLocale()) : '';
};

export const getImageUrl = (serverUrl, itemId, imageType = 'Primary', options = {}) => {
        if (serverUrl && isPlexServer(serverUrl)) return plexImageUrl(serverUrl, itemId, imageType, options);
        if (!serverUrl || !itemId) return null;
        const params = {};
        if (options.maxWidth) params.maxWidth = options.maxWidth;
        if (options.maxHeight) params.maxHeight = options.maxHeight;
        if (options.quality) params.quality = options.quality;
        if (options.tag) params.tag = options.tag;
        const queryString = buildQueryString(params);
        return `${serverUrl}/Items/${itemId}/Images/${imageType}${queryString ? '?' + queryString : ''}`;
};

// Resolves Seerr or TMDB artwork, which can be absolute, protocol-relative, or a path on its server.
export const toAbsoluteImageUrl = (url, serverUrl) => {
        if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return null;
        if (url.startsWith('http://') || url.startsWith('https://')) return url;
        if (url.startsWith('//')) return `https:${url}`;
        if (!serverUrl) return url;
        if (url.startsWith('/')) return `${serverUrl}${url}`;
        return `${serverUrl}/${url}`;
};

export const getBackdropId = (item) => {
        if (!item) return null;
        // Only return ID if the item actually has backdrop images
        if (item.BackdropImageTags?.length > 0) {
                return item.Id;
        }
        // Check for parent backdrop (for episodes/seasons)
        if (item.ParentBackdropItemId && item.ParentBackdropImageTags?.length > 0) {
                return item.ParentBackdropItemId;
        }
        return null;
};

ahora si pasan los fondos correctamente, pero no admite la nomenclatura fanart1, para los siguientes fondos deben ser backdrop1...

¡Genial! Entonces ya rota correctamente. En Jellyfin, la nomenclatura que debemos respetar es:

Backdrop → fondo principal.
Backdrop1 → segundo fondo.
Backdrop2 → tercer fondo.
Backdrop3 → cuarto fondo.
No debemos usar Fanart1, porque Jellyfin identifica estos fondos como imágenes de tipo Backdrop con índices consecutivos.

No hace falta renombrar los archivos manualmente si ya están cargados en Jellyfin y aparecen en BackdropImageTags: Moonfin debe recorrer esos índices automáticamente.

si los tengo que renombrar porque los tengo nombrados como fanart, que es lo que reconoce kodi, no se si kodi reconocera bacdrop como fanart, creo que no....

Correcto: Kodi y Jellyfin utilizan convenciones de nombres distintas.

Kodi reconoce habitualmente fanart.jpg, fanart1.jpg, fanart2.jpg, etc.
Jellyfin utiliza backdrop como tipo de imagen y, para archivos locales, sus nombres de imagen siguen su propia convención.
Cambiar fanart por backdrop podría hacer que Kodi dejase de reconocerlos como fondos, dependiendo de cómo esté configurada la biblioteca.
Por tanto, no te recomiendo renombrar los originales: podrías solucionar Jellyfin y estropear Kodi.

La buena noticia es que no necesitas renombrarlos: Jellyfin también reconoce fanart.jpg como primer fondo y extrafanart/fanart1.jpg, fanart2.jpg, etc., como fondos adicionales. Kodi mantiene su propia convención y también reconoce esos nombres. <Cite refs={["turn862296search0","turn862296search4","turn862296search5"]}/>
